reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Purified recombinant NT liposome leakage, lipid-binding pelleting, TEM and size-selective dextran release; conditional cytosolic add-back.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation and transfer check of prior primary Methods, supplements or validated protocols; local validation and acknowledging absent packet methods do not by themselves satisfy this action.

Core protein preparation/cleavage and lipid formulation/buffer conditions remain unresolved lists rather than a quantitative preparation-to-intervention workflow or a concrete source/calibration-to-setting procedure. Proposed protein concentration series alone does not specify the essential reconstitution.

Baseline/lysis tolerances are explicit, but no free-reporter/protein interference or graded reporter-recovery calibration distinguishes optical dequenching from actual passage in the primary assay and size panel.

Independent preparations and a pilot are recognized, but no quantitative power/precision target with an effect/variance-to-sample-size decision is supplied; a proposed three/six-preparation floor is not a justified confirmatory sample size.

Primary fluorescence is coded, but the required manual TEM pore classification/field selection has neither blinded systematic sampling nor an equivalent locked rule. This is a distinct bias in the claimed physical mechanism.
Sample expansion to 6 and later 6-9 after seeing small/ambiguous effects lacks a fixed maximum or prespecified information rule; this permits outcome-dependent sampling.

The main contrast and model are named, but model assumptions/diagnostics and a fully specified uncertainty/multiplicity procedure for the panel are incomplete. Naming a mixed model is not sufficient execution detail.

All-or-none versus graded bulk leakage is not a unique discriminator of detergent-like disruption versus pores; pores can produce heterogeneous/all-or-none vesicle escape, and bulk averaging conceals that. The added size/imaging tests are stronger but do not make this stated principle correct.

A bounded concentration panel is supplied, but no pilot-to-confirmatory lock prevents choosing the most informative dose from the main results. Dose range is not the same as a prospective selection policy.
Troubleshooting does not explicitly delimit permitted changes, refreeze the revised procedure and require fresh independent confirmation after such changes.
No complete raw-unit-to-output audit trail with sample identifiers, exact analysis versions/settings and preserved failed/excluded runs is specified.
Activity on selected inner-leaflet lipid mixtures does not demonstrate protection of neighboring intact cells. Their lipid accessibility, exposure and susceptibility have not been tested.
The evidence table labels CT inhibition and specific caspase identities high-confidence packet-derived inferences; those are not established by the supplied generic cleavage/NT-toxicity packet.

Meaningful direct pore-versus-indirect-versus-disruption hypotheses and a feasible protein/vesicle system. Prospective buffer, matched purification protein, precursor and positive-disruption controls have explicit purposes. Most quantities are proposed and format is within 5,000 words; unsupported packet attributions are charged only at G7.

historical_match_reason: Direct pore question, intrinsic assembly mechanism, purified NT/FL on defined lipid panels, TEM plus size-selective passage, and the explicit joint positive prediction match the continuation. Numerical/optical/selection gaps reduce Q2; they do not eliminate the independent structural-plus-functional positive-core experiment. No exact historical lipid recipe or pore dimension is required.
